text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years spent with Almond 
Eye came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Good morning, Ai. How are you feeling 
today?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm in top shape!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The full set menu I couldn't finish 
yesterday... I feel like I can totally 
clear it today!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's update the menu to reflect 
that

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By the way, about our jog after 
this...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after leaving a glorious legacy 
across her first three years, Almond Eye 
remains completely unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! Good work out there!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look at all that sweat! Even though 
we only did a light jog!
choice_data_list:
Still, you got serious halfway through, 
didn't you...!

Still, you got serious halfway through, 
didn't you...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If I were serious, I'd have arrived at 
the academy long ago!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still... hehe. You kept on running, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You really do hate losing, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Ai! Come run with Boo and the 
others!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Blast! And—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I just came up with an amazing plot twist! 
If I win with this, it's gonna be so much 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan! I'll beat you at your 
strongestâand win for sure this time!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You could say Kiseki-san's pretty 
hot-blooded... She's a really 
straightforward girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh? Aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Just bein' able to race against you is 
enough for me, Ai-san. Opportunities like 
this don't come around often anymore, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I won't say I'll win. Just—I won't 
break. I'll go for the win, again and 
again.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu, ufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Very well, let us duel! However, the 
victor will be—

text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec!!" his

text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai, we're here too! Don't forget 
all the possibilities out there waiting to 
beat you!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye. I would like to have your 
schedule as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The heat from the other day hasn't left my 
body yet. —Grant me a serious match, will 
you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Looks like Ai-san is running...!" 
"Eek~, let's watch!" "Someday, I want 
to..." "Ai-chan, do your best~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fervent gazes converge upon Almond Eye. 
And the look in her eyes as she receives 
them is, of course—
choice_data_list: Now then... what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's already decided! No 
matter who the opponent is—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I will beat every last one of you! —Let us 
begin!
